title: Adverbial participles
subtitle: Test time, cause, means, concession, and condition against context.
overview: An anarthrous participle often adds circumstance to a main verb. Its form does not by itself tell you whether English needs when, because, although, or by doing.
Parse agreement and voice first; then choose the relation that best fits the surrounding paragraph without claiming false certainty.
